provider.deidentificationBoundary: The demo uses ciphered identifiers and consistently shifted subject dates. No displayed date is interpreted as a real calendar date.

methodology.labSelection: latest numeric record per declared item at or before cutoff and within lookback
methodology.prescriptionSelection: records whose declared start/stop interval overlaps cutoff
methodology.prescriptionSemantics: prescription record only; not medication administration or adherence
methodology.missingnessRule: a pair missing any declared frame lab is ineligible
methodology.shiftedDateSemantics: The demo uses ciphered identifiers and consistently shifted subject dates. No displayed date is interpreted as a real calendar date.

cohort.selectionRule: First five ascending subject_id values with at least two admissions, one ICU stay, one procedure record, one prescription record, and all four declared numeric labs in the 24 hours ending at the latest ICU outtime.

nonClaims: A diagnosis code would remain a recorded code, not a confirmed diagnosis.
A prescription record is not a medication administration record.
Missing laboratory data is not normal laboratory data.
Similar bounded frames do not establish patient identity or clinical equivalence.
Shifted dates are not real calendar dates.
The five-subject cohort is not representative of a clinical population.
The source projection is not mutated by analysis.
